text:
[Council File 26-1341]
Motion (Yaroslavsky, Nazarian - Harris-Dawson) relative to establishing a fee deferral program that allows developers to pay impact fees at a later date instead of requiring upfront payment at building permit issuance.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The city would let developers delay paying impact fees until after receiving building permits, rather than requiring upfront payment.
